description: Answer "is it open now?", "when does it close?" and "is it open on Thanksgiving?" for one business in the VoiceAssistants directory. Returns whether it is open at this moment in its own time zone, today's hours, the full week, and any holiday hours on file. If the business has no hours on file it says so rather than guessing. Pass the `id` from find_businesses. Read `spoken` aloud.
name: get_hours
title: Check a business's hours
